We know how frustrating accidents can be, so we're here to make the repair process smooth, honest, and worry-free. as quick as possible. From dents to full paint jobs, we treat every car like it’s our own. | Why Choose Us | We're not just about fixing cars—we're about taking care of people. When you choose Professional CPC, you're choosing a team that’s friendly and experienced. We work with all major insurance companies, use top-notch tools and paint, and keep you updated every step of the way. Most of all, we care about doing the job right—and making sure you leave with a smile. | Book Your Estimate Appointment | Schedule a free estimate with our expert technicians at your convenience to revive your ride. | Schedule Now | Our Services | What We Offer | 01 | Collision Repairs and Painting | From fender benders to major accidents, we’ve got you covered. Our skilled team uses top-quality materials, PPG renifihing systems and precision techniques to repair damage and restore your vehicle’s finish so it looks like it never happened. | 02 | Body Structural & Non-Structural Repairs | Whether it's frame straightening or fixing dents and panels, we handle all types of body repairs. We’ll make sure your vehicle is not only safe and sound to get back on the road. | 03 | Welding | Some repairs need more than just parts and paint—they need solid, skilled welding to restore the strength and structure of your vehicle. Our shops counts with state of the art equipment and certified technicians to perform MIG welding and spot welding on steel bronze and aluminium using industry-approved methods. | 04 | Car Pick Up and | Drop Off | We get it—life’s busy. That’s why we offer convenient car pickup and drop-off services. Whether you're stuck at home, work, or just don’t have the time, we’ll come to you and pick up your vehicle, handle the repairs, and bring it back when it’s all done. | 05 | Free On Site Estimates | No need to guess or stress— Stop by, and we’ll give you a quick, accurate estimate at the shop or we can asses at your location. Our team will take a close look at the damage, explain what needs to be done, and answer any questions you have. | 06 | Rental Car Agreements | We make renting a car easy. We’ll help you arrange a rental through one of our trusted partners. Whether you need a car for a day or the entire repair period, we’ll make sure you stay on the road while we take care of your vehicle. | 07 | Insurance Claim Handling | We’re not here only to revive your ride - we will deal with your insurance claim as well. We work directly with your insurance company to streamline the process and get your car repaired as quickly and smoothly as possible. | What Clients Say | My experience with the Collision Center was extraordinary. I called them because I was in an emergency situation after a significant accident. I needed my car urgently, so I took it to them right away. They gave me a very reasonable quote, and just two days later, they called to tell me my car was ready. The personalized attention was outstanding—they even took me to Hertz to rent a car, and when I returned it, they told me to drop it off at their shop, and they would handle the return.
